name: supabase-guard
description: Supabase exposure rules before SQL runs or a migration is written (execute_sql, apply_migration, migration-file Write/Edit): blocks a table without RLS, a view without security_invoker, an unrevoked or search_path-less SECURITY DEFINER, and an unmarked GRANT to anon/authenticated; warns on a function without search_path. Same rules as the lint-supabase-rules PR gate.
